events.title: Book Launch with Nathan Hale — In conversation with Nidhi Chanani

cases.refreshed: We are incredibly excited to welcome New York Times bestselling author-illustrator Nathan Hale to the store to celebrate the launch of Nathan Hale's Hazardous Tales: The Web of War! Nathan will be in conversation with bestselling author Nidhi Chanani. After their conversation, Nathan and Nidhi will battle in an old-fashioned, no-holds-barred Draw-OFF! This event is free, but you must purchase a copy of The Web of War from Linden Tree to enter the signing line. Books can be purchased with an event ticket, in person at Linden Tree, or on our website. In the summer of 1944, the Allied forces carried out the largest seaborne invasion in military history. American, British, and Canadian soldiers took to the skies and the sand, bombarding the beaches of Normandy, France, in the famous operation known as D-Day. This pivotal battle turned the tides against the Nazis, but how did the French find themselves overtaken by enemy forces to begin with? How did Hitler and his Nazi ideology sweep through Germany so quickly? And how did American military service members and civilians, from generals, to war correspondents, to heroic Black soldiers, work together to defeat the Nazi government and bring an end to Hitler's reign of terror? In The Web of War, history is in your hands! Pick your path and unravel the thrilling, shocking, gruesome, and true stories of the Second World War in this all-new hazardous tale.
